goal: Make the sidebar Workspace board render and move single linked workspaces through their confirmed GitHub Project or Linear workflow phase without using workspaceStatus as lifecycle truth.

acceptance_criteria.outcome: Opening the Workspace board renders Todo, In Progress, In Review, Ready to Test, and Done and places linked cards from externally confirmed tracker phase without reading workspaceStatus as lifecycle truth.
A single GitHub-linked card move updates the mapped GitHub Project status and persists the confirmed canonical phase on the workspace.
A single Linear-linked card move updates the mapped Linear workflow state and persists the confirmed canonical phase on the workspace.
Refreshing the Workspace board after an external GitHub or Linear status change places the card in the newly reported lane.
An unlinked workspace appears in an explicit Unlinked state and a lane move is blocked with a Link tracker action without persisting workspaceStatus.
Rejected, unavailable, and unmapped tracker moves render an error and preserve the prior lane, trackerPhase, workspaceStatus, and cross-lane rank.

tasks.objective: Add a worktree-owned single-card tracker transition route and Linear external-state reconciliation, reusing the existing provider transition, event, mapping, tracker-id, and registry persistence seams so only Applied outcomes persist canonical phase.
contracts: Register POST /api/worktrees/transition-tracker with camelCase { worktreeId, targetPhase }; accept exactly todo, in_progress, in_review, ready_to_test, or done.
Reload and validate the registered github or linear binding before dispatch; reuse tracker_sync::resolve_binding and expose the existing tracker_id_for as pub(crate) without changing its behavior.

For GitHub, require a Project binding and require its requested option id to map uniquely back to targetPhase before dispatch, so the task sink's unbound-label path and legacy InReview fallback cannot count as a Workspace board move.
For Linear, require the configured target state name to map uniquely back to targetPhase before dispatch; let the existing provider seam report a team that lacks that state as Skipped.
Call task_sink::apply_tracker_transition with AppState.bus and Some(worktree_id); never duplicate or modify provider transition logic.
Persist TrackerPhase::wire_str through the existing registry path only for TransitionResult::Applied, and return success only after that persistence succeeds.
Map invalid or unlinked input, Skipped, transport failure, and persistence failure to non-success responses; none may alter tracker_phase or any workspaceStatus field.

Register POST /api/worktrees/reconcile-linear-status with camelCase { worktreeId, stateName }; uniquely map the configured trimmed case-insensitive state name or return { reconciled: false, phase: null } without writing.
Preserve the existing reconcile-github-status request, response, option-id validation, and backward reconciliation behavior.
Name new focused tests with workspace_board_tracker so one cargo filter runs the route persistence/failure and Linear inverse-mapping coverage.
non_goals: Do not edit task_sink provider behavior, GitHub Project bindings, tracker credentials, status mappings, event payloads, or retry semantics.
Do not change automated session-start, PR/merge, harness, MCP, or tracker-attention transition decisions; tracker_sync changes only the visibility of tracker_id_for.
Do not restore /api/board, board_items, a board mirror, a bulk endpoint, a provider registry, or another provider.
Do not write, delete, migrate, or reinterpret legacy workspaceStatus metadata.

tasks.objective: Replace the drawer's configurable workspaceStatus lifecycle with fixed tracker lanes, generation-safe GitHub and Linear refreshes, pessimistic single-card moves, explicit Unlinked/error handling, and focused UI regressions while preserving unrelated board mechanics.
contracts: Render a fixed ordered list of Todo, In Progress, In Review, Ready to Test, Done, and non-lifecycle Unlinked; workspaceStatus and saved workspaceStatuses are not lane inputs.
A supported linked card uses the latest reconciled provider phase, falling back only to confirmed trackerPhase and the existing no-phase Todo baseline while refresh is pending.

Export an imperative GitHub Project status resolver over IssueProjectStatusChip's existing caches/fetchers and keep the existing hook behavior; reuse uncached linearGetIssue for explicit board refresh.
Refresh visible linked cards on drawer open and window focus/visibility, reconcile provider evidence through the typed worktree clients, and discard stale generations.

Allow exactly one linked worktree per lifecycle drop; perform no optimistic lane or cross-lane rank change, and commit the returned canonical phase only after the transition client resolves successfully.
On a same-lane manual reorder, preserve manualOrder behavior without an external call; after a successful cross-lane move, persist only manualOrder changes and never workspaceStatus.
Unlinked moves perform no client or metadata write and show an error toast with a Link tracker action opening that repo's existing Project Integrations settings target.
Rejected, unavailable, skipped, or unmapped moves report the error and preserve prior phase, workspaceStatus, and cross-lane rank.
Reject multi-card lifecycle drops before any transition call while retaining existing multi-selection and bulk pin behavior.

Remove arbitrary lifecycle status editing and lane-local create-in-status controls from this drawer while retaining layout, filter, close, resize, selection, pin, card activation, sorting, and drag mechanics.
non_goals: Do not change the shared workspaceStatus schema, persistence, default definitions, sidebar grouping, context-menu organization, or sidebar drop behavior outside the drawer.
Do not add a tracker setup or existing-workspace binding wizard; route the action to existing repo Project Integrations settings.
Do not add polling, a store slice, a second event subscription, bulk transitions, provider mapping logic in TypeScript, or providers beyond GitHub and Linear.
Do not alter WorktreeCard issue/Linear presentation, board pinning, filters, area selection, outside-dismiss, column resizing, or manual-order helper semantics.
